descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As Finance Excellence Partner (FxP) you collaborate with Commercial Finance colleagues across Diagnostics and beyond geographical boundaries in a networked team, to streamline finance operations by simplifying, standardizing, automating, and utilising insights for enhanced decision making. You also collaborate closely with local Finance Enterprise Partners, finance colleagues across the global Roche finance network and local commercial business partners. You contribute to fostering a culture of innovation and experimentation as well as drive automation and digitalization across finance. Your key responsibilities Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Being the liaison to various stakeholders across the global Roche finance network (e.g. local Finance Enterprise Partners, Roche Shared Service Center, Finance Excellence Partner chapter) on several major finance processes (Month End Closing, Budget, Forecasting, Performance Tracking).
• Leveraging technology and automation to drive digitalization as well as exploring and applying new technologies and tools in the fields of automation and Artificial Intelligence.
• Ownership of reporting solutions (sales, P&L, Headcount, Balance sheet) and providing key insights to local commercial affiliate on major KPIs.
• Identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains, promoting continuous improvement through standardised processes and tools in order to be brilliant at the basics.
• Collaborating closely with Finance Enterprise Partners and internal commercial stakeholders to enable increased customer experience and business impact along the customer journey.
• Acting as an enabler for the adaption of the new ways of working by shifting from affiliate focused finance operations towards an above country-cluster level Your profile
• Ability to work and thrive in a networked environment, cross-departments, stakeholders, hierarchies and geographies in order to work successfully across affiliates, sub-regions and regions with an enterprise perspective combined with an agile mindset.
• Capability to constantly challenge the status quo and successfully influence stakeholders to implement key change initiatives.
• Profound understanding and experience of key financial processes (Month End Closing, Annual Closing, Budgeting, Forecasting and Actual Performance Monitoring) and financial accounting principles.
• Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and a growth mindset.
• Actively seeking input and building relationships with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.
• Robust analytical skills, including business process improvement expertise.
• A strong business understanding to drive innovation effectively.
• An inclusive and collaborative approach to how you work.
• Growth mindset and living the Roche Operating Principles.
• English and French - written and spoken. [FRENCH VERSION] En tant que Finance Excellence Partner (FxP) , vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Finance Commerciale au sein de Roche Diagnostics ainsi qu’avec des collègues à l’international, au sein d’une équipe connectée. Votre mission principale est de contribuer à l’excellence opérationnelle financière en simplifiant, standardisant et automatisant les processus, tout en apportant des insights pertinents pour éclairer la prise de décision. Vous jouez également un rôle central dans la promotion de l’innovation, de la numérisation et d’une culture d’expérimentatio
